messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: api-gateway-east-1 high 5xx rate (502/504) — 15m avg error rate 22% > threshold. Pager: @sara_oncall. Runbook: https://runbooks.redwood/ingress-5xx, telemetry: https://telemetry/redwood/alerts/2839991122
sara_oncall: I’m on it — joining live triage. Can someone confirm customer scope and roughly which frontends are affected?
ben_prod: quick snapshot: spike started 2026-03-17T04:13:10Z, error mix ~70% 502 / 30% 504. Errors concentrated on ingress-pool-7 (proxy-az-a). Global frontend latency also up ~200ms.
maria_sre: Not seeing broad region failover yet — health checks show backend pools healthy. Logs show many `upstream reset by peer` from edge-proxy to mux. Possible connection exhaustion.
jon-eng: Rolling `netstat` & conntrack show sockets piling up on the edge-proxy pods in pool-7. Might be ephemeral connection leak when upstream mux scaled down recently.
sara_oncall: Customer impact? Lucy, can support comment on any customer reports?
lucy-support: One enterprise customer (acme-corp) reported increased 502s to their agent at 04:20 UTC via support DM. No broad page from customers yet. I'll draft a public note if we need to escalate.
ben_prod: Telemetry: top path /v1/generate shows 22% errors, but non-streaming endpoints less affected. Could be long-lived connections/keepalive mismatch.
maria_sre: Suggested mitigation options: 1) shift traffic away from ingress-pool-7 to standby pool; 2) enable connection-draining and restart affected edge-proxy pods; 3) bump upstream mux replicas. Recommend (1) + (2) for fastest recovery.
jon-eng: I can start a targeted drain for pool-7 and then restart pods. Proposed command:
```
# cordon pool-7
kubectl label node pool=ingress-pool-7 maintenance=true
# scale down edge-proxy deployment gracefully
kubectl rollout restart deploy/edge-proxy -n infra --field-selector=spec.nodeSelector.pool=ingress-pool-7
```
This will trigger connection drain and new pods schedule elsewhere.
sara_oncall: Before we restart, can we try traffic-shift to standby region to reduce customer impact? ops-bot, can you kick a traffic-shift runbook?
ops-bot: Executing traffic-shift play: region fallback -> standby-east-1. Rolling 10% -> 50% -> 100% with 2min ramps, health checks enforced. Triggered by @sara_oncall. Play ID: ts-283999-1.
ben_prod: Starting 10% shift now. Watch metrics for errors and latency.
maria_sre: Also enabling circuit-breaker on API gateway route for connections > 5s to limit pileups.
lucy-support: Drafting customer message: "We are investigating elevated 5xx errors impacting some requests in US-East. Mitigation in progress; we will update within 30 minutes." Will post once you confirm scope.
ben_prod: 10% shift complete — immediate error rate drop in telemetry for shifted traffic (errors down from 22% -> 3% on standby). Good signal that issue is local to pool-7.
jon-eng: Proceeding with drain+restart on pool-7 now. Rolling restarts in batches of 3 pods.
```
# restart snippet
kubectl get pods -n infra -l app=edge-proxy,zone=pool-7 -o name | xargs -n1 kubectl delete -n infra --grace-period=30
```

sara_oncall: Monitor for regressions. Maria, if restarts don't stabilize within 8 minutes, escalate to global fallback and prepare for full traffic-shift.
maria_sre: Roger. Watching KV cache hit rates and upstream TCP resets.
ben_prod: After first batch restart error rate for pool-7 dropped to 6% within 90s. Overall cluster errors now at 7%. Continuing restarts.
lucy-support: Posted initial customer note to status page (draft): https://status.redwood/incident/INC-283999 — will update with timeline.
jon-eng: Final batch restart completed. All edge-proxy pods in pool-7 back healthy. Connection counts normalized.
ben_prod: Current summary: error rate 5m avg down to 2.1%, latency back within SLOs. No further customer escalations as of now.
sara_oncall: Great work. Keeping incident channel open for 30m for observation. @lucy-support please update status page with stable message and customer-impact cleared once we hold for 15m.
lucy-support: Will update status in 10m.
maria_sre: I'll follow up with post-incident action items: investigate root cause of connection exhaustion, verify keepalive settings between edge-proxy and mux, and add alert to detect pool-level socket buildup earlier.
ops-bot: Incident created: INC-283999, severity: high -> reduced to mitigated. Timeline attached.
sara_oncall: Handoff: I'm wrapping up. Next on-call @matt_oncall takes over at 05:00 UTC. If anyone sees a regression ping in #oncall.
ben_prod: Agreed — I'll prepare a short runbook note on the restart steps we executed.
lucy-support: Status updated: "Mitigated — traffic shifted & targeted restarts resolved elevated 5xxs. Monitoring."
jon-eng: Adding logs & Pod dumps to the incident ticket for root cause.
sara_oncall: Thanks team. Closing active mitigation. Keeping channel for postmortem notes. :white_check_mark:
